title: ToolRegistryEntry
description: Phase 2 Capability–Connection–Authority Preflight: registry entry for a Tool/Connector/Agent that may act on behalf of the operator. No specialist execution adapters.

capability_ids.description: Capability registry ids this tool can serve

required_permissions.description: Permission keys that must be evidenced before Authorized claim

connect_instructions.description: How to enable/connect this connector (shown when disconnected)

credential_env_keys.description: Env keys whose presence is weak evidence only (credential_present, not Connected)

allows_manual_fallback.description: Manual user work allowed only after Preflight proves no ready tool

execution_phase.description: phase3_or_later = registry only in Phase 2; no dispatch
